COMPENDIUM OF MCZMA DECISION ORDERS, ENVIRONMENT DEPARTMENT CLARIFICATION LETTERS, CRZ NOC GRANTS, AND REJECTION PROCEEDINGS IN MAHARASHTRA COASTAL REGION
SUBJECT: Statutory Record of MCZMA Meeting Minutes (2001-2005), Detailed Review of State Environment Department Letter dated Feb 15, 2003 regarding Adarsh CHS (Plot CS No. 652/653, Colaba), Delegated Coastal Clearance Interpretation, JNPT Port Extension Sanctions, and Enforcement Notices.

1. STATUTORY DECISION-MAKING POWERS OF MCZMA & MOEF

1.1 The Maharashtra Coastal Zone Management Authority (MCZMA) was constituted by the Ministry of Environment and Forests (MoEF), Government of India, under Section 3(3) of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986. MCZMA acts as the statutory state-level regulatory body to examine coastal clearance proposals and enforce the CRZ Notification 1991.

1.2 Under the delegation of powers scheme, MCZMA evaluates applications and forwards projects requiring Ministry approval to MoEF, New Delhi. State Environment Department officers cannot independently override MoEF clearance mandates or misinterpret delegation limits.

2. MASTER DECISION & CLEARANCE STATUS LOG (2001–2005)

3. CRUCIAL EXAMINATION OF FEB 15, 2003 STATE CLARIFICATION LETTER

3.1 Context of Letter Ref `ENV-2002/2192/CR-88/TC-3`: On February 15, 2003, the Environment Department, Government of Maharashtra, issued a formal letter to the Urban Development Department and MCGM regarding Plot CS No. 652/653 (Adarsh CHS), Colaba. The letter was signed by the Under Secretary / Secretary (Environment).

3.2 Misinterpretation of Delegated Clearance: The letter stated that as per amendments to the CRZ Notification, development proposals in CRZ-II areas had been delegated to the local planning authority (MCGM) under DCR 1991, and therefore separate environmental clearance from the Ministry of Environment and Forests (MoEF), Government of India, was not required.

3.3 Subsequent Invalidation: MCZMA and MoEF subsequently clarified in 2010–2011 that the February 15, 2003 letter was legally unauthorized, as state officers had no power to waive mandatory MoEF clearance under the CRZ Notification 1991 for residential buildings in CRZ-II.

4. ENFORCEMENT PROCEEDINGS & DEMOLITION NOTICES (2011)

4.1 MoEF Demolition Order (January 16, 2011): The Ministry of Environment and Forests issued a final direction under Section 5 of the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, ordering the demolition of the 31-storey Adarsh building within 3 months for operating without valid CRZ clearance.

5. ROUTINE MCZMA QUARTERLY AUDIT & BUDGETARY RECORDS

5.1 Annual Operating Expenses: MCZMA administrative expenditure and scientific GIS mapping grants sanctioned for FY 2003-04.

By Order of the Authority:


(DR. SURESH JOSHI / V. K. JAIN)
Principal Secretary (Environment) & Chairman, MCZMA
Government of Maharashtra, Mantralaya, Mumbai
